Speaker: Hrefna
Text: Six weeks I waited. Heart, skull, flesh, bones, nightshade. I did it all right. I know I did.
Notes: Hrefnas Wut ueber die spaete Antwort der Familie; Reihenfolge/Kontext der Zeilen laut Konzept-Fliesstext, kein vollstaendiges Skript belegt

Speaker: Hrefna
Text: You came. *Now* you come. Where were you when he took the farm and my husband took to the bottle?

Speaker: Player
Text: The family was burning. No one was left to answer.

Speaker: Hrefna
Text: So I answered myself. Held him under till the bubbles stopped. It was quieter than I thought.

Speaker: Veyra
Text: Grief kills once. Sithis wants those who can kill twice.

Speaker: Hrefna
Text: There's a letter on his table. To a daughter. I... can't.
Notes: Am Bett des Agenten Quintus Aufidius

Speaker: Player
Text: If he lives, he hangs you for doing what the Brotherhood should have done.

Speaker: Player
Text: Then you're no use to us. And neither is your silence.

Speaker: Player
Notes: Option 3 von 3; Pruefung NICHT bestanden, fuehrt zu Flag Unproven

Speaker: Hrefna
Text: Twice now. It doesn't get quieter.
